name: delia-hmsc
description: DELIA HMSC Solidity contract (M5, SC-001/002/006): local development/testing tooling only. The SRS's own experimental deployment target (GAP-50) is a private 10-node Geth-compatible PoA network; Hardhat here runs a real EVM against the same compiled bytecode for day-to-day unit testing, which TRACKER.md's M5 section records as reasonable engineering tooling distinct from that target, not a protocol deviation. Version pins follow the sibling systems/dht-backed project's precedent (Hardhat v2, ethers v6, no plugin beyond ethers).
